title: Storage-neutral exact polynomial invariants
objective: Define CPython-parseable storage-neutral exact polynomial invariant, squarefree, radical, and factor-root contracts with Sage 10.9 edge semantics and Sage.js dynamic differential coverage

handoff.summary: Added an ordinary CPython-parseable semantic layer for leading and constant coefficients, valuation, parent-aware monic construction, domain-owned content, squarefreeness, squarefree decompositions, radicals, and exact default-parent root extraction from mature factor lists. Callbacks keep FLINT resources, packed storage, parent coercion, scalar-content policy, factorization, and result construction outside the contract. Sage.js and CPython tests pin SageMath 10.9 ZZ/QQ behavior for zero, constants, signed scalar units, parent widening, multiplicities, and default root domains. A hash-indexed root pass preserves an equality fallback for unhashable exact elements.
risks: This is an unwired contract module; public PolynomialElement integration must supply generated resource operations and must not turn the callbacks into coefficient-by-coefficient host crossings.

The contract deliberately defines zero as not squarefree in both exact domains, following the mathematical contract and task requirement even though SageMath 10.9's QQ implementation currently reports True.

ZZ squarefreeness and radicals require a mature scalar callback for the FLINT factorization unit because the generated backend retains integer content as a scalar rather than expanding its prime factors as constant polynomials.
next_steps: Add invariants.py to the strict Pyright and node test manifests in the integration lane.
Wire the public ZZ and QQ polynomial methods to these contracts using generated FLINT resource callbacks for content, factorization, squarefree decomposition, and monic/result construction.
Retain the CPython and dynamic witnesses as differential oracles when native public wiring is added.
